summary: Further url lookup options: GSSAPI auth, whether to use ~/.netrc, honoring proxy environment variables, username, and certificate validation.
questions: How do I stop the url lookup from using my ~/.netrc credentials?
Can the url lookup bypass the HTTP proxy environment variables?
How do I disable SSL certificate checks in the url lookup?
Does the url lookup support Kerberos/GSSAPI authentication?

answer_card.title: url lookup options (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `use_gssapi` (default false): GSSAPI auth; since 2.11 credentials can come from `username`/`password`
- `use_netrc` (default true): set false to ignore `~/.netrc`
- `use_proxy` (default true): set false to ignore proxy env vars
- `username`: HTTP auth username
- `validate_certs` (default true): set false to skip TLS validation
